article.headline: Tony Williams scores 29 points and Fairfield edges LIU 74-71
article.description: — Tony Williams scored 29 points as Fairfield beat LIU 74-71 on Sunday.
article.linkText: Tony Williams scores 29 points and Fairfield edges LIU 74-71

categories.description: Fairfield Stags @ Long Island University Sharks

event.description: Fairfield Stags @ Long Island University Sharks

keywords: Fairfield Stags @ Long Island University Sharks
article.story: NEW YORK -- — Tony Williams scored 29 points as Fairfield beat LIU 74-71 on Sunday. Williams also contributed six steals for the Stags (4-2). Declan Wucherpfennig scored 20 points and added 13 rebounds. Peyton Smith shot 3 of 7 from the field and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with nine points. Tyrell Bowles led the way for the Sharks (1-7) with 20 points, 14 rebounds, two steals and five blocks. Jakhi Howard added 14 points for LIU. DeShawn Jean-Charles finished with 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
